title: 御定佩文韻府·卷二十六之九 (vol 435)
shelf_note: A Siku Quanshu manuscript copy of the Peiwen yunfu (Qing imperial phrase dictionary). It is a Chinese reference work in the 'universallibrary' collection. Nothing is wrong with the shelf.
structure_note: Only 8 of 131 records carry a printed number. This leaf shows the block-heart title 欽定四庫全書 / 卷二十六之九, and its folio number falls outside the frame. With so few numbered pages, the 3 backsteps and 2 repeats are more likely misread or misplaced block-heart numerals than a scan splice. The structure count gives pages_translated 0 against a field value of 126, so one of the two counters is wrong (E2). The record count and page numbering are otherwise consistent: 131 records and 131 distinct page numbers.

pages.printed_marker: 欽定四庫全書 … 卷二十六之九 (block heart; no folio number visible)
pages.layout: Single half-folio of vertical text in a ruled frame with 16 columns. The block heart at the right edge carries the collection title and juan. The new headword 相繆 is set in large characters in the second-to-last columns, and repeated headwords are abbreviated as 丨丨.

tr_errors.source: 晉陽秋祖逖劉琨俱以雄豪著名
tr_errors.english: In the *Annals of Jin Yang*: "Zu Ti and Liu Kun were both famous for their heroic spirit.
tr_errors.problem: 晉陽秋 is Sun Sheng's Jin chunqiu: 陽 replaces 春 to avoid a taboo name. The title means 'Annals of Jin', and 'Jin Yang' suggests a place or a person that is not there.

tr_errors.source: 江淹詩契濶承華內丨丨踰歲年
tr_errors.english: Sharing hardship within the Chenghua palace, we were **intimately bound** for more than a year.
tr_errors.problem: 踰歲年 means 'for years on end', not 'more than a year'. The change is small.

tr_errors.english: Yanzhi became known for his scholarly attainments.
tr_errors.problem: 業尚 means his conduct and aspirations. 'Scholarly attainments' narrows the meaning slightly.

other.note: The <meta> asserts that the previous page's content was the Shijing 'mulberry bark … window and door' line (鴟鴞). That cannot be seen on this leaf, although it is plausible for the entry 綢繆.

missing.english: Sharing hardship within the Chenghua palace
missing.why: Chenghua (承華) was the crown prince's palace. Without that, the line's courtly setting is lost.
The title is a taboo substitution for 'Annals of Jin' (Jin chunqiu). Without a note, the reader takes 'Jin Yang' for a place or an author.

missing.english: like bundled thorns, my feelings are **tightly bound**
missing.why: 'Bundled thorns' (束楚) echoes the Shijing's binding images of marriage and loyalty, and the simile is opaque without that.

book_verdict: The transcription matches the leaf character for character, including the 丨丨 abbreviations and the new headword 相繆. The translation is faithful, apart from a mistranslated book title (晉陽秋) and small slips. The notes are accurate but several identify works and allusions the page does not carry.
